description: Assign a finding to an organisation member, or clear its assignment. Requires write permission. Assignment can notify the assignee by email and Slack and synchronise connected issue trackers. For several findings, use assign_findings. Someone who isn't on Odin yet (a finding's ownerNotOnOdin) can't be assigned until an owner or admin invites them in the web app. Assignee "odin" asks Odin to fix it: where the organisation lets agents assign Odin, Odin drafts the fix as a pull request as you (it spends credits) and hands the finding back with it; otherwise the result is "needs confirmation" with a link for the person to confirm in Odin. Only do this when the person asks for it.

assigneeUserId.description: Organisation member user ID, "odin" to assign Odin (it drafts the fix), or null to clear assignment.

expectedAssigneeUserId.description: Only reassign if the current assignee is still this user ID (null for unassigned); otherwise Odin refuses with a conflict and nothing changes.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: assign_finding
title: Assign a finding
